relationships.subject: Cannabidiol
relationships.evidence_quote: the other major cannabinoid, cannabidiol (CBD) is a potent activator of TRPV1

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: Activation of TRPV1 can also cause the release of neuropeptides, such as CGRP and SP, from the peripheral and central nerve endings.

relationships.subject: Cannabinoid receptor 1
relationships.evidence_quote: if CBR1 and TRPV1 are expressed in the same neuron, the CBR1-mediated reduction in cAMP levels could downregulate TRPV1 expression and function by reducing the phosphorylated state of the channel
